source.name: Natural Earth Admin 1 States and Provinces

method.generalization: Closed-ring Ramer-Douglas-Peucker for polygons without holes; all vertices are retained for polygons with holes. Every source polygon/island/hole is retained; collapsing or orientation-changing rings fall back to their original vertices.
method.classification: Even-odd containment in the packaged generalized geometry, using the existing latitude-band algorithm separately for each retained country class.
method.country_condition: A subdivision can be assigned only if its country_id equals the unchanged country-index row. No nearest state/province or place-text matching.
method.boundary: Any ring edge or overlap produces admin1-boundary; holes/coastal gaps remain admin1-outside.
method.limitations: Approximate, generalized, de facto geographic containment in a pinned source. Not authoritative current administrative jurisdiction or positional uncertainty. Ring simplification is not asserted to preserve shared-edge topology.

coverage_note: The 50m admin-1 product covers only USA/Canada; 10m is used for Mexico and the other retained countries. Mexico has 32 named entities plus a source unnamed minor-island unit; units are not all called states.
